title.en: Startup Club Faculty Advisor and Entrepreneurship Curriculum Committee Member, Sogang University

description.ko: 서강대학교 정규 창업동아리 지도교수이자 창업교과 운영위원으로서, 창업 교과목 운영과 비교과 프로그램, 상시 창업 멘토링을 통해 학생들의 창업을 지원합니다.
description.en: As faculty advisor to an official startup club and a member of the entrepreneurship curriculum committee at Sogang University, supports student startups through entrepreneurship courses, extracurricular programs and ongoing mentoring.
